expr: (() => { const svg = document.querySelector('#minimapSvg'); const g = svg.querySelector('g'); const r = svg.getBoundingClientRect(); const mk = (t, x, y) => new PointerEvent(t, { clientX: x, clientY: y, pointerId: 7, pointerType: 'touch', bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); const x0 = r.left + 40, y0 = r.top + 60; const before = g.getAttribute('transform'); svg.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerdown', x0, y0)); svg.dispatchEvent(mk('pointermove', x0 - 40, y0 + 30)); svg.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerup', x0 - 40, y0 + 30)); window.__pan2 = before !== g.getAttribute('transform'); return window.__pan2; })()
(() => { const b = document.querySelector('.pointer-badge.clickable'); if (!b) throw new Error('no badge'); b.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', inline: 'center' }); return true; })()
